017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client.mcp.auth;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020
021/**
022 * Signals that an MCP call was rejected with a SEP-2350 {@code 401}/{@code 403 insufficient_scope} step-up challenge.
023 *
024 * <p>
025 * A caller-supplied {@link McpStepUpAuthorizer.ScopedCall} throws this (carrying the parsed
026 * {@link WwwAuthenticateChallenge}) so {@link McpStepUpAuthorizer} can compute the scope union, re-authorize, and retry.
027 * It is deliberately <b>not</b> an {@link McpAuthException}: the transient step-up signal must be distinguishable from
028 * the permanent authorization failure the authorizer ultimately throws when retries are exhausted.
029 *
030 * @since 10.0.0
031 */
032public class McpInsufficientScopeException extends RuntimeException {
033
034   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
035
036   // Non-transient: WwwAuthenticateChallenge is Serializable (a scheme string + immutable string map), so the
037   // challenge survives serialization and the challenge() "Never null" guarantee holds after a round-trip.
038   private final WwwAuthenticateChallenge challenge;
039
040   /**
041    * Constructor.
042    *
043    * @param challenge The parsed {@code WWW-Authenticate} challenge from the server.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
044    */
045   public McpInsufficientScopeException(WwwAuthenticateChallenge challenge) {
046      super("MCP call rejected with an insufficient_scope step-up challenge: "
047         + assertArgNotNull("challenge", challenge).scopes());
048      this.challenge = challenge;
049   }
050
051   /**
052    * Returns the parsed challenge carrying the required scopes for the current operation.
053    *
054    * @return The challenge.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
055    */
056   public WwwAuthenticateChallenge challenge() {
057      return challenge;
058   }
059}
